objects.name: Instructions
objects.string: Welcome to Twardy 2.0! You can move using WASD, punch by left-clicking, use items by right-clicking, and place builds using B. You're goal is to survive and uncover the secrets of Mark's ancestors. THIS GAME WILL BE UPDATED OVERTIME. Tap on this message to close it.
